Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 146: The Human-shaped Crutch Is More Useful

On the final day of the sports meet, the main attractions were no longer just the students of No. 1 Affiliated High School, but also their teachers.

After the men's 3000-meter race ended yesterday, the competitive events for students had more or less concluded.

The total scores for each class at the sports meet had also been tallied.

Through the efforts of the entire class, Grade 10 Class 8 achieved the excellent result of third place in their year.

The two classes ahead of them, Class 10 and Class 16, both had several sports-specialty students participating, who had won many gold medals, so their scores were a bit higher than Class 8's.

Under such circumstances, it was already quite impressive for Class 8, which had no sports-specialty students, to secure third place.

And so on Saturday, starting from eight in the morning, it was time for some fun competitions.

The rules were simple too. The head teacher of each class had to participate and invite a subject teacher to be their assistant.

Then, among the five fun competitions, if only two people were needed, the two teachers would complete the event together.

If more people were required, the head teacher would have to ask their own students for help, inviting enough students to make up the numbers for the competition.

All the students from Grade 10 to Grade 12 had gathered in their respective stands early on.

Once the time came, they saw their own head teachers, along with their assistant teachers, walking from Houde Road onto the sports field, and then heading straight toward their own class's section.

And when the students of Grade 10 Class 8 saw that Kong Junxiang was accompanied by the English teacher, Teacher Ding Xiang, they all started hooting and hollering, winking and nudging each other.

"Old Kong is up to no good," Zhu Yufei whispered with a sly laugh. "But speaking of which, Old Kong is not even thirty yet, and Teacher Ding is a master's graduate who just returned from studying abroad. She's probably two or three years younger. Suddenly, I feel like they're quite a good match."

"Teacher Ding is so pretty today," Xu Yinghuan also giggled foolishly, having spotted the highlight at a glance. "Teacher Ding is wearing makeup. She usually wears light makeup, but today's is so exquisite."

"Is there a difference?" Li Luo looked closely, but really couldn't see any distinction. "It looks like she barely has any lipstick on."

"Look at the eyeshadow, and her eyebrows are drawn too. The contouring on her nose and jawline is also done very well," Xu Yinghuan analyzed for him in a low voice. "The lipstick is a light shade, it makes her look younger. It's not like that heavy European or American style of makeup."

"You really know your stuff, Xu Yinghuan."

"This is a necessary skill for girls, okay?" Xu Yinghuan huffed. "I learned a lot from my mom back in middle school."

"Is that so?" Li Luo looked at Yan Zhusheng beside him. "Can you tell?"

Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "I can't."

"Then according to Xu Yinghuan's theory, Yan Zhusheng, you're not a girl."

"I am," Yan Zhusheng said in all seriousness. "I just don't wear makeup."

With Yan Zhusheng's natural looks, at least in her teenage years, there was indeed no need for makeup.

At most, she could use some light makeup for a bit of enhancement, apply a touch of lipstick to brighten her lip color, making her look more energetic and full of spirit.

In fact, in Li Luo's memory, even when she was in her thirties, Yan Zhusheng didn't have much of a habit of wearing makeup.

After all, she didn't show her face in the short videos Li Luo produced; she just focused on singing.

She spent most of her time at home, so there was really no need for makeup.

The Yan Zhusheng of that time had shed her youthful rawness and immaturity, but retained that delicate face. Her overall temperament had become colder and more distant.

During the six months Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng spent together in their previous life, they worked together for at least four of those months before Yan Zhusheng's attitude towards Li Luo slowly warmed up from that distant state.

But the fifteen or sixteen-year-old Yan Zhusheng of this life had a much fainter high-and-mighty air. That was just the first impression she gave people.

Upon actual interaction, she felt more naturally and adorably dorky, speaking bluntly and directly, which further highlighted a certain endearing simplicity.

After all, there was a gap of more than ten years, so it was normal for her personality to be somewhat different.

Li Luo thought to himself, in his previous life, without him around, what would Yan Zhusheng's situation in Class 8 have been like?

After entering university and stepping into society, what kind of things would she have encountered that led to her lack of social skills, to the point that she developed a protective layer of aloofness toward people?

"The competition is starting!" Xu Yinghuan pointed down below at that moment.

Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang were already taking part in the first competition.

The rules of the game were very simple. Each group of teachers would get three balloons. The two of them had to stand back-to-back, sandwich a balloon in between, and then transport it twenty meters away.

Once they reached the finish line, they had to work together to pop the balloon by squeezing it between their backs before they could run back to the starting point to transport the second balloon.

On the sports field, most of the assistant teachers the head teachers had found were of the same gender as them; either male teachers paired with male teachers, or female teachers with female teachers.

So, a male-female pair like Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang was quite conspicuous among them.

Out of a total of sixteen classes in Grade 10, only two pairs of teachers were male-female combinations.

One of those pairs was even a married couple.

"Go, Teacher Kong!" Zhu Yufei took the lead and shouted from the stands.

Seeing their teacher on the field, the students of Class 8 all laughed and cheered him on.

"Teacher Kong, use some force! You can't even pop that?"

"This is killing me, what is Teacher Kong doing? Going easy on her because she's a girl?"

"Whoa, I see the base of Old Kong's ears are all red, hahahaha."

"Teacher Ding is much calmer than him. She's even holding Teacher Kong's hand, teaching him how to squeeze."

"Lame! So lame!" Zhang Guohuang shook his head with a "tsk." "Old Kong is still too green. Don't tell me he's never been in a relationship before?"

"Looks like he's going to be completely wrapped around Teacher Ding's finger."

"One henpecked husband down, next."

The students joked and teased from the stands, while their head teacher and English teacher competed valiantly on the field.

After discovering that Ding Xiang didn't have the coy and bashful attitude of traditional girls, Kong Junxiang started to loosen up a bit.

Apart from being a little slow at the start of the balloon transport, he performed better and better in the following competitions.

After all, both he and Ding Xiang were considered young among the teachers, so they had a physical advantage.

After the five competitions were over, they had actually managed to take first place twice.

After splitting a gold medal each with Teacher Ding, Kong Junxiang returned to the stands with a beaming smile, his happiness obvious to anyone.

"Teacher Kong, when can we drink to your wedding?" Zhang Guohuang sidled up and boldly whispered.

Kong Junxiang shot him an annoyed glance. "Not enough homework, is that it? When we get back to the classroom, I'll give you two more worksheets."

"Two is too few," Teacher Ding shook her head from the side. "Zhang Guohuang, your English was the worst on the mid-term exam. I'll arrange four or five more for you."

A wave of laughter erupted from the surrounding students.

Meanwhile, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng had already disappeared from the stands.

After the fun competitions ended, each class lined up and entered the field in an orderly fashion, assembling in the center of the sports ground.

The school leaders walked up to the rostrum, and the sports meet's closing ceremony officially began.

No one was very interested in the school leaders' long-winded speeches, but they were all craning their necks in anticipation.

It wasn't until the principal finished speaking and the rhythmic beat of a drum set sounded from behind the red curtain on the rostrum that everyone's spirits lifted, and they began peeking and craning their necks towards the stage.

The five members of the rock club arrived as promised, appearing before all the students after the red curtain was drawn back.

When the crowd heard Yan Zhusheng's singing once more, they quickly became immersed in this musical feast.

It wasn't until the song ended, amid the principal's announcement of the successful conclusion of the sports meet, that everyone felt a sense of wistful loss, realizing that this year's sports meet was truly over.

The Grade 10 and 11 students didn't feel it as strongly, but the Grade 12 students knew that after this sports meet, they would be facing the college entrance exams next year, and there would be no more high school sports meets for them.

However, being able to hear a girl like Yan Zhusheng sing her heart out for them at this year's sports meet was, in its own way, a rare and precious memory.

"I forgot to tell you this morning."

After the sports meet ended, everyone dispersed and returned to their classrooms.

Li Luo spoke to Yan Zhusheng as he packed his things. "Xixi's knee is injured, so I told her to just rest up at home today and not come over to your place with us."

Yan Zhusheng blinked, then asked, "What about Qiao Xinyan and Zhao Rongjun?"

"We'll let Zhao Rongjun off the hook for now. As for Qiao Xinyan, she'll probably keep Xixi company."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded, slung her backpack over her shoulder, and walked out of the classroom with Li Luo, her steps a little lighter. "Then let's take Xixi home first."

The two of them went upstairs to the Class 1 classroom.

By now, Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan had already packed their schoolbags.

Qiao Xinyan directly helped Ying Chanxi put on her backpack, letting her walk out with a crutch, and they ran right into Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng.

The moment she saw Li Luo, Ying Chanxi glanced at Yan Zhusheng out of the corner of her eye, then silently handed the crutch in her hand to Qiao Xinyan as well.

Then she pointed at the space in front of her and looked at Li Luo. "You, come here."

"...Don't you have a crutch?"

"You, this human-shaped crutch, are more useful."

"Heh."

"Auntie Lin said she'll come over after she's done with work at noon."

"As you wish."

Li Luo put on a fawning smile and squatted down in front of Ying Chanxi.

Ying Chanxi nodded with satisfaction, and with a push of her feet, she pounced onto Li Luo's back, hugging his neck tightly.

Li Luo cupped her little bottom with his hands and carried her all the way down the stairs.

Qiao Xinyan and Yan Zhusheng followed beside them, helping to carry their backpacks.

"By the way, where's the upperclassman sister?" Li Luo asked.

"The sports meet is over, but the student council still has a lot of wrap-up work to do," Ying Chanxi said from his back. "She'll probably be busy for a while this afternoon before she can go home."

"Alright then, I'll take you home first," Li Luo said, then turned his head to look at Qiao Xinyan. "Are you coming to our place to hang out today? Keep Xixi company, and you can stay for dinner tonight. I'll have my mom take you home."

"Sure!" Qiao Xinyan was already very familiar with them, so she wasn't polite at all, nodding happily in agreement. "What about you and Yan Zhusheng?"

"We have something to do this afternoon. We'll be back in the evening when we're done."

Hearing what Li Luo said, Ying Chanxi, who had been quite happy on his back, suddenly let out a soft huff.

Even though her injured knee gave her a legitimate reason to have Li Luo carry her, why couldn't she be completely happy about it?

Ying Chanxi was a little down. After being carried back to 1502 by Li Luo and sitting down on the sofa, she watched helplessly as Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng left together and closed the door behind them.

"Xixi, what are you thinking about?"

"Xinyan, can you go to my bedroom and get something for me?"

(End of this chapter)
